records.statement:
theorem pressure_firstIntegral_hasDerivAt
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k p lam μ s : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => k * (deriv θ t) ^ 2 / 2 -
      (lam - p * yCoord θ 0 t) * cos (θ t) -
      (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 t) * sin (θ t)) 0 s
records.proof:
by
  have ht := (hθ.differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hκ := ((hθ.deriv' (n := 2)).differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hX := hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  have hY := hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  have hmoment := (hκ.const_mul k).unique hAngle
  convert (((hκ.pow 2).const_mul k).div_const 2).sub
    (((hasDerivAt_const s lam).sub (hY.const_mul p)).mul ht.cos) |>.sub
      (((hasDerivAt_const s μ).add (hX.const_mul p)).mul ht.sin) using 1
  norm_num only [Nat.reduceSub, pow_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q * deriv θ s) hmoment]
records.comment:
The force components are `(lam - p Y, mu + p X)`. Their tangent projection
has a quadratic-curvature first integral, derived from the angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angleForce_hasDerivAt
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {p lam μ s : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t =>
      p * (xCoord θ 0 t * cos (θ t) + yCoord θ 0 t * sin (θ t)) -
        lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t))
      (p - ((lam - p * yCoord θ 0 s) * cos (θ s) +
        (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 s) * sin (θ s)) * deriv θ s) s
records.proof:
by
  have ht := (hθ.differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt
  have hX := hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  have hY := hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ.continuous 0 s
  convert ((((hX.mul ht.cos).add (hY.mul ht.sin)).const_mul p).sub
    (ht.sin.const_mul lam)).add (ht.cos.const_mul μ) using 1
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => p * q) (sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ s))]
records.comment:
The pressure contribution to the differentiated moment equation is exactly
`p`, using unit arclength speed. The other term is the tangential force.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      (k * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / 2 -
        (lam - p * yCoord θ 0 s) * cos (θ s) -
        (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 s) * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = p)
records.proof:
by
  have hfirst : ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / 2 -
        (lam - p * yCoord θ 0 s) * cos (θ s) -
        (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 s) * sin (θ s) = σ := by
    apply isOpen_Ioo.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_Ioo 0 ℓ).isPreconnected
    · intro s hs
      exact (pressure_firstIntegral_hasDerivAt hθ (hAngle s hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro s hs
      exact (pressure_firstIntegral_hasDerivAt hθ (hAngle s hs)).deriv
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hfirst
  refine ⟨σ, fun s hs => ⟨hσ s hs, ?_⟩⟩
  have hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv θ) := hθ.deriv' (n := 2)
  have heq : deriv (fun t => k * deriv θ t) =ᶠ[𝓝 s]
      (fun t => p * (xCoord θ 0 t * cos (θ t) + yCoord θ 0 t * sin (θ t)) -
        lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t)) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with t ht
    exact (hAngle t ht).deriv
  have hsecond := ((pressure_angleForce_hasDerivAt (p := p) (lam := lam)
    (μ := μ) (s := s) hθ).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv
  have hfun : deriv (fun t => k * deriv θ t) =
      (fun t => k * deriv (deriv θ) t) := by
    funext t
    exact ((hκ.differentiable (by norm_num) t).hasDerivAt.const_mul k).deriv
  rw [hfun, ((hκ.differentiable_deriv_two s).hasDerivAt.const_mul k).deriv] at hsecond
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q * deriv θ s) (hσ s hs)]
records.comment:
The same constant in the force first integral yields the forced curvature
equation. The second derivative is obtained from the actual angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angle_curvature
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = p
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := pressure_angle_firstIntegral_curvature hθ hAngle
  exact ⟨σ, fun s hs => (hσ s hs).2⟩
records.comment: Projection to the curvature equation, with pressure as its explicit forcing.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angle_phase_energy
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨σ, heq⟩ := pressure_angle_curvature hθ hAngle
  have hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (deriv θ) := hθ.deriv' (n := 2)
  have hforced : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = k * (p / k) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [heq s hs]
    field_simp
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := LinearInputCurvatureBridge.forced_energy_constant (ne_of_gt hk) hκ hforced
  refine ⟨σ, c, fun s hs => ⟨hc s hs, ?_⟩⟩
  exact LinearInputCurvatureBridge.forced_phase_hasDerivAt (ne_of_gt hk) hκ (hforced s hs)
records.comment:
Pressure determines the phase input `u = p / k`, which may be nonzero. These are actual
coordinate derivatives and a constant energy along arclength.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_angle_eq_phase_energy
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv (fun t => k * deriv θ t) s =
      p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) :
    ∃ σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  apply pressure_angle_phase_energy hk hθ
  intro s hs
  have hd := ((hθ.deriv' (n := 2)).differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt.const_mul k
  exact hd.congr_deriv (hd.deriv.symm.trans (hAngle s hs))
records.comment:
Equality of actual first derivatives suffices; C3 regularity supplies the
HasDerivAt form used by the preceding pressure-to-phase theorem.

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_xCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (xCoord θ 0)
records.proof:
by
  apply contDiff_one_iff_deriv.mpr
  refine ⟨fun s => (hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ 0 s).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  have hd : deriv (xCoord θ 0) = fun s => cos (θ s) :=
    funext (deriv_xCoord hθ 0)
  rw [hd]
  exact Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_yCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (yCoord θ 0)
records.proof:
by
  apply contDiff_one_iff_deriv.mpr
  refine ⟨fun s => (hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ 0 s).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  have hd : deriv (yCoord θ 0) = fun s => sin (θ s) :=
    funext (deriv_yCoord hθ 0)
  rw [hd]
  exact Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_area_weight {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun s =>
      xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s))
records.proof:
((contDiff_xCoord hθ.continuous).mul hθ.cos).add
    ((contDiff_yCoord hθ.continuous).mul hθ.sin)
records.comment: The spatial weight in the actual area variation is C¹.

records.statement:
theorem weighted_angleEquation_of_stationary {θ M w : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ p : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) +
        p * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv M s = p * w s - lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hm⟩ := exists_multipliers_of_kernel
    (firstVariationLinear ℓ M hM.continuous +
      p • constraintLinear ℓ w hw.continuous)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => -sin (θ s)) hθ.sin.continuous.neg)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => cos (θ s)) hθ.cos.continuous) hstat
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun s =>
      p * w s + (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s))) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul hw).add
      ((contDiff_const.mul hθ.sin).add (contDiff_const.mul hθ.cos))
  have hangle := residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary hℓ hM hq (by
    intro η
    have hi : (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        (p * w s + (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s))) * η.val s) =
        p * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * η.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) := by
      have hadd : (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
          (p * w s + (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s))) * η.val s) =
          ∫ s in 0..ℓ, p * w s * η.val s +
            (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) * η.val s := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s _
        ring
      rw [hadd]
      have hi₁ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => p * w s * η.val s) volume 0 ℓ :=
        ((continuous_const.mul hw.continuous).mul η.property.1.continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hi₂ : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun s => (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) * η.val s) volume 0 ℓ :=
        (((continuous_const.mul hθ.sin.continuous).add
          (continuous_const.mul hθ.cos.continuous)).mul
            η.property.1.continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hi₁ hi₂]
      have hp : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, p * w s * η.val s) =
          p * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * η.val s) := by
        simp_rw [mul_assoc]
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
      rw [hp, force_integral hθ.continuous η]
      ring
    rw [hi]
    have hh := hm η
    change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) +
      p * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * η.val s) +
      lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 at hh
    linarith)
  refine ⟨lam, μ, fun s hs => ?_⟩
  calc
    deriv M s = p * w s + (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) := hangle s hs
    _ = _ := by ring
records.comment:
Two endpoint constraints give two force multipliers even with a spatial
loading term.  This is the finite-codimensional and integration-by-parts step.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_pressureEnergy_variation_feasible {k p ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => pressureEnergy k p (angleVariation θ η.val t) ℓ)
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, k * deriv θ s * deriv η.val s) +
        p * (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
          (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have he := hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ
    (show ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) by fun_prop) hθ η.property.1
  have hd (q : ℝ) : deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) q = k * q :=
    (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt k q).deriv
  simp_rw [hd] at he
  have ha := LinearInputAreaVariation.hasDerivAt_area_variation_feasible
    hℓ hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous hx hy
  exact he.add (ha.const_mul p)
records.comment:
Genuine differentiation of the full functional, using the independently
proved signed-area derivative.  Feasibility removes its boundary contribution.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff_firstVariation {k p ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) :
    Stationary k p θ ℓ ↔
      ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, k * deriv θ s * deriv η.val s) +
          p * (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
            (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  unfold Stationary
  constructor <;> intro h η hx hy
  · have hdx := (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation hℓ hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have hdy := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation hℓ hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have he := (hasDerivAt_pressureEnergy_variation_feasible
      (k := k) (p := p) hℓ hθ η hx hy).deriv
    rw [← he]
    exact h η (hdx.trans hx) (hdy.trans hy)
  · have hdx := (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation hℓ hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have hdy := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation hℓ hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous).deriv
    have hx' := hdx.symm.trans hx
    have hy' := hdy.symm.trans hy
    rw [(hasDerivAt_pressureEnergy_variation_feasible
      (k := k) (p := p) hℓ hθ η hx' hy').deriv]
    exact h η hx' hy'
records.comment: The integral characterization is a consequence of actual derivatives.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_angleEquation {k p ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : Stationary k p θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv (fun t => k * deriv θ t) s =
        p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
          lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  exact weighted_angleEquation_of_stationary hℓ hθ1
    (contDiff_const.mul (hθ.deriv' (n := 2))) (contDiff_area_weight hθ1)
    ((stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le hθ1).mp hstat)
records.comment:
Actual stationarity of bending energy plus signed area gives the pressure
angle equation; the formula is a conclusion, not a hypothesis.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_curvature {k p ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : Stationary k p θ ℓ) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = p
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hangle⟩ := stationary_angleEquation hℓ hθ hstat
  apply LinearInputPressureCurvature.pressure_angle_curvature hθ
  intro s hs
  have hd := ((hθ.deriv' (n := 2)).differentiable (by norm_num) s).hasDerivAt.const_mul k
  exact hd.congr_deriv (hd.deriv.symm.trans (hangle s hs))
records.comment:
The forcing p in the curvature equation is derived from the actual area
term in the curve functional.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_phase_energy {k p ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : Stationary k p θ ℓ) :
    ∃ σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      LinearInputDesign.E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (LinearInputGradient.gy (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-LinearInputGradient.gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hangle⟩ := stationary_angleEquation hℓ hθ hstat
  exact LinearInputPressureCurvature.pressure_angle_eq_phase_energy hk hθ hangle
records.comment:
End-to-end pressure connection: actual constrained stationarity of a curve
functional gives the quartic phase input u=p/k and its conserved energy.

records.statement:
theorem areaStationary_exists_pressure {k ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hstat : AreaStationary k θ ℓ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ, Stationary k p θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)
  have hw : Continuous w := (contDiff_area_weight hθ).continuous
  have hM : Continuous (fun s => k * deriv θ s) :=
    continuous_const.mul hθ.continuous_deriv_one
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, p, hm⟩ := LinearInputConstraints.exists_three_multipliers_of_kernel
    (firstVariationLinear ℓ (fun s => k * deriv θ s) hM)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => -sin (θ s)) hθ.sin.continuous.neg)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => cos (θ s)) hθ.cos.continuous)
    (constraintLinear ℓ w hw) (by
      intro η hx hy ha
      have hdx := (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation hℓ hθ.continuous
        η.property.1.continuous).deriv
      have hdy := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation hℓ hθ.continuous
        η.property.1.continuous).deriv
      have hda := (LinearInputAreaVariation.hasDerivAt_area_variation_feasible
        hℓ hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous hx hy).deriv
      have he := (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ
        (show ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) by fun_prop)
          hθ η.property.1).deriv
      have hd (q : ℝ) : deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) q = k * q :=
        (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt k q).deriv
      simp_rw [hd] at he
      change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, k * deriv θ s * deriv η.val s) = 0
      rw [← he]
      exact hstat η (hdx.trans hx) (hdy.trans hy) (hda.trans ha))
  refine ⟨p, (stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ hθ).mpr ?_⟩
  intro η hx hy
  have hh := hm η
  change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, k * deriv θ s * deriv η.val s) +
    lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
    μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) +
    p * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * η.val s) = 0 at hh
  simpa only [hx, hy, mul_zero, add_zero] using hh
records.comment:
The pressure coefficient can be derived as an area multiplier.  No
independence assumption is needed for this implication from stationarity.

records.statement:
theorem areaStationary_phase_energy {k ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : AreaStationary k θ ℓ) :
    ∃ p σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      LinearInputDesign.E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (LinearInputGradient.gy (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-LinearInputGradient.gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := areaStationary_exists_pressure hℓ.le (hθ.of_le (by norm_num)) hstat
  obtain ⟨σ, c, hc⟩ := stationary_phase_energy hℓ hk hθ hp
  exact ⟨p, σ, c, hc⟩
records.comment:
The area-constrained stationary curve has a pressure multiplier and hence
the corresponding forced quartic phase energy.

records.statement:
theorem constraint_coefficients_zero {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ a b c : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K)
    (h : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      a * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      b * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) +
      c * (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s) = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0
records.proof:
by
  classical
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · have hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      push Not at hn
      exact hnonconst ⟨0, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := Elastica.constraint_coefficients_zero hℓ hθ1 hne (by
      intro η
      simpa only [hc, zero_mul, add_zero] using h η)
    exact ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩
  · let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => c * xCoord θ 0 s + b
    let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => c * yCoord θ 0 s - a
    let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => A s * cos (θ s) + B s * sin (θ s)
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => -(A s * sin (θ s)) + B s * cos (θ s)
    have hA : ContDiff ℝ 1 A :=
      (contDiff_const.mul (LinearInputPressureStationary.contDiff_xCoord hθ.continuous)).add contDiff_const
    have hB : ContDiff ℝ 1 B :=
      (contDiff_const.mul (LinearInputPressureStationary.contDiff_yCoord hθ.continuous)).sub contDiff_const
    have hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q := (hA.mul hθ1.cos).add (hB.mul hθ1.sin)
    let η : variationSpace ℓ := ⟨fun s => s * (ℓ - s) * q s,
      ⟨(contDiff_id.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)).mul hq, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
    have hint : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0 := by
      have hi : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (-a * sin (θ s) + b * cos (θ s)) * η.val s) +
          c * (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
            (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s) := by
        have hi₁ : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun s => (-a * sin (θ s) + b * cos (θ s)) * η.val s) volume 0 ℓ :=
          ((((continuous_const.mul hθ1.sin.continuous).add
            (continuous_const.mul hθ1.cos.continuous)).mul η.property.1.continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
        have hi₂ : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun s => c * ((xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) +
              yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
          ((continuous_const.mul ((LinearInputAreaVariation.continuous_moment hθ.continuous).mul
            η.property.1.continuous)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_add hi₁ hi₂]
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s _
        dsimp [q, A, B]
        ring
      rw [hi, force_integral hθ.continuous η]
      exact h η
    have hz : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, s * (ℓ - s) * (q s) ^ 2) = 0 := by
      convert hint using 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      change s * (ℓ - s) * q s ^ 2 = q s * (s * (ℓ - s) * q s)
      ring
    have hzero := residual_zero_of_weighted_square_integral hℓ hq.continuous hz
    have hdq (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt q (c + deriv θ s * F s) s := by
      have ht := (hθ1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt
      have hx := (hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ.continuous 0 s).const_mul c |>.add_const b
      have hy := (hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ.continuous 0 s).const_mul c |>.sub_const a
      convert (hx.mul ht.cos).add (hy.mul ht.sin) using 1
      dsimp [F, A, B]
      nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ => c * v) (sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ s))]
    have hdF (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (-deriv θ s * q s) s := by
      have ht := (hθ1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt
      have hx := (hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ.continuous 0 s).const_mul c |>.add_const b
      have hy := (hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ.continuous 0 s).const_mul c |>.sub_const a
      convert ((hx.mul ht.sin).neg).add (hy.mul ht.cos) using 1
      dsimp [q, A, B]
      ring
    have hrel : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, c + deriv θ s * F s = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      have heq : q =ᶠ[𝓝 s] fun _ => 0 := by
        filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with t ht using hzero t ht
      exact (hdq s).unique ((hasDerivAt_const s (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq)
    have hFd : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt F 0 s := by
      intro s hs
      simpa only [hzero s hs, mul_zero] using hdF s
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, F s = d := by
      apply isOpen_Ioo.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_Ioo 0 ℓ).isPreconnected
      · intro s hs
        exact (hFd s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · intro s hs
        exact (hFd s hs).deriv
    have hmid : ℓ / 2 ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ := by constructor <;> linarith
    have hdne : d ≠ 0 := by
      intro hd0
      have hm := hrel (ℓ / 2) hmid
      rw [hd (ℓ / 2) hmid, hd0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hm
      exact hc hm
    exfalso
    apply hnonconst
    refine ⟨-c / d, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    apply (eq_div_iff hdne).2
    have hr := hrel s hs
    rw [hd s hs] at hr
    linarith
records.comment:
Nonconstant curvature makes the two endpoint differentials and the area
moment differential independent. The true area differential differs from the
moment by a linear combination of the first two differentials.

records.statement:
theorem exists_normalized_constraint_directions {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K) :
    ∃ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ,
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ξ₁.val s) = 1 ∧
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ξ₁.val s) = 0 ∧
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) +
         yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * ξ₁.val s) = 0) ∧
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ξ₂.val s) = 0 ∧
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ξ₂.val s) = 1 ∧
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) +
         yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * ξ₂.val s) = 0) ∧
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ξ₃.val s) = 0 ∧
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ξ₃.val s) = 0 ∧
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) +
         yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * ξ₃.val s) = 1)
records.proof:
by
  let cx := constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => -sin (θ s)) hθ.sin.continuous.neg
  let cy := constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => cos (θ s)) hθ.cos.continuous
  let ca := constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s))
    (LinearInputAreaVariation.continuous_moment hθ.continuous)
  let C : variationSpace ℓ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) := cx.prod (cy.prod ca)
  have hev (f : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (x y z : ℝ) :
      f (x, (y, z)) = f (1, (0, 0)) * x + f (0, (1, 0)) * y + f (0, (0, 1)) * z := by
    have hp : (x, (y, z)) = x • (1, (0, 0)) + y • (0, (1, 0)) + z • (0, (0, 1)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [hp, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have ha : (LinearMap.range C).dualAnnihilator = ⊥ := by
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    intro f hf
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator] at hf
    have habc : f (1, (0, 0)) = 0 ∧ f (0, (1, 0)) = 0 ∧ f (0, (0, 1)) = 0 := by
      apply constraint_coefficients_zero hℓ hθ hnonconst
      intro η
      have hfc : f (C η) = 0 := hf (C η) ⟨η, rfl⟩
      change f (cx η, (cy η, ca η)) = 0 at hfc
      rw [hev] at hfc
      exact hfc
    change f = 0
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro p
    change f (p.1, (p.2.1, p.2.2)) = 0
    rw [hev, habc.1, habc.2.1, habc.2.2]
    ring
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective C :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp (Submodule.dualAnnihilator_eq_bot_iff.mp ha)
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, h₁⟩ := hsurj (1, (0, 0))
  obtain ⟨ξ₂, h₂⟩ := hsurj (0, (1, 0))
  obtain ⟨ξ₃, h₃⟩ := hsurj (0, (0, 1))
  refine ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, ξ₃, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst h₁, congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) h₁, congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) h₁⟩
  · exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst h₂, congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) h₂, congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) h₂⟩
  · exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst h₃, congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) h₃, congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) h₃⟩
records.comment:
Three fixed-angle variations can independently correct endpoint position
and area moment when the curvature is not constant.

records.statement:
theorem pressure_coefficient_unique {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p₁ p₂ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K)
    (hp₁ : LinearInputPressureStationary.Stationary k p₁ θ ℓ)
    (hp₂ : LinearInputPressureStationary.Stationary k p₂ θ ℓ) : p₁ = p₂
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, ξ₃, _, _, h₃⟩ :=
    exists_normalized_constraint_directions hℓ hθ hnonconst
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hv₁ := (LinearInputPressureStationary.stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le hθ1).mp
    hp₁ ξ₃ h₃.1 h₃.2.1
  have hv₂ := (LinearInputPressureStationary.stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le hθ1).mp
    hp₂ ξ₃ h₃.1 h₃.2.1
  rw [h₃.2.2, mul_one] at hv₁ hv₂
  linarith
records.comment:
The pressure multiplier is unique on a fixed nonconstant-curvature curve.
This does not assert that the multiplier is nonzero, and it does not apply to
the constant-curvature cases where the third differential loses rank.

records.statement:
theorem areaStationary_of_constant_curvature {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k K : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hconst : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K) :
    LinearInputPressureStationary.AreaStationary k θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  intro η _ _ _
  have he := hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ.le
    (show ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) by fun_prop) hθ1 η.property.1
  have hd (q : ℝ) : deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) q = k * q :=
    (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt k q).deriv
  simp_rw [hd] at he
  rw [he.deriv]
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le
    (f := fun s => (k * K) * η.val s)
    (f' := fun s => k * deriv θ s * deriv η.val s)
    hℓ.le (continuous_const.mul η.property.1.continuous).continuousOn
    (fun s hs => by
      simpa only [hconst s hs] using
        ((η.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (k * K)))
    (((continuous_const.mul hθ1.continuous_deriv_one).mul
      η.property.1.continuous_deriv_one).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
  simpa only [η.property.2.1, η.property.2.2, mul_zero, sub_self] using hi
records.comment:
At constant curvature the pure bending first variation vanishes for every
fixed-angle direction. No exact-constraint correction or rank hypothesis is
needed; this includes straight curves.

theorem hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral_any
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {D : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] E}
    {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D))
    (hd : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q s) (D p s) p) (p₀ : Parameters) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p₀ s) p₀
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall p₀ 1).prod (isCompact_uIcc : IsCompact (uIcc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hD.continuousOn
  have hGs (p : Parameters) : Continuous (G p) := hG.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hDs (p : Parameters) : Continuous (D p) := hD.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (s := ball p₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => C) (ball_mem_nhds p₀ one_pos)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun p => (hGs p).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((hGs p₀).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hDs p₀).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [] with s hs
    intro p hp
    exact hC (p, s) ⟨ball_subset_closedBall hp, uIoc_subset_uIcc hs⟩
  · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  · filter_upwards [] with s _ p _
    exact hd p s

records.proof: hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral_any hG hD hd p₀

theorem contDiff_two_parameter_intervalIntegral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {D : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] E}
    {D₂ : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] (Parameters →L[ℝ] E)}
    {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D))
    (hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂))
    (hd : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q s) (D p s) p)
    (hd₂ : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => D q s) (D₂ p s) p) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s)
records.proof:
by
  have h₁ := hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hG hD hd
  have h₂ := hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hD hD₂ hd₂
  have heq : fderiv ℝ (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s) = fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p s :=
    funext fun p => (h₁ p).fderiv
  rw [show (2 : WithTop ENat) = 1 + 1 from rfl, contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv]
  refine ⟨fun p => (h₁ p).differentiableAt, by simp, ?_⟩
  rw [heq, contDiff_one_iff_fderiv]
  refine ⟨fun p => (h₂ p).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  have heq₂ : fderiv ℝ (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p s) = fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D₂ p s :=
    funext fun p => (h₂ p).fderiv
  rw [heq₂]
  exact continuous_parameter_intervalIntegral hD₂

records.statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters
    {ρ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hB : Continuous B)
    (p : Parameters) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ρ (κ s + B s p))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s) p
records.proof:
by
  have hp : Continuous (fun q : Parameters × ℝ => κ q.2 + B q.2 q.1) :=
    (hκ.comp continuous_snd).add ((hB.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply continuous_fst)
  apply hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral
    (G := fun p s => ρ (κ s + B s p))
    (D := fun p s => deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s) hℓ (hρ.continuous.comp hp)
    ((hρ.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  intro p s
  exact (hρ.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
    ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_two_integral_linear_parameters
    {ρ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ρ) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hB : Continuous B) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ρ (κ s + B s p))
records.proof:
by
  let D := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) => deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s
  let D₂ := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) =>
    (deriv (deriv ρ) (κ s + B s p) • B s).smulRight (B s)
  have hp : Continuous (fun q : Parameters × ℝ => κ q.2 + B q.2 q.1) :=
    (hκ.comp continuous_snd).add ((hB.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply continuous_fst)
  have hρ₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv ρ) := hρ.deriv'
  have hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D) :=
    ((hρ₁.continuous.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  have hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂) := by
    dsimp [D₂, Function.uncurry]
    exact (isBoundedBilinearMap_smulRight (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Parameters)
      (F := Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ)).continuous.comp
      (((hρ₁.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd)).prodMk
        (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  apply contDiff_two_parameter_intervalIntegral
    (G := fun p s => ρ (κ s + B s p)) (D := D) (D₂ := D₂)
    hℓ (hρ.continuous.comp hp) hD hD₂
  · intro p s
    exact (hρ.differentiable (by norm_num) _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))
  · intro p s
    exact ((hρ₁.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))).smul_const (B s)

theorem continuous_smulRight_parameter
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {A : Parameters × ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {B : Parameters × ℝ → F}
    (hA : Continuous A) (hB : Continuous B) :
    Continuous (fun q => (A q).smulRight (B q))
records.proof:

    (hA.prodMk hB)

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_two_integral_mul
    {A B : Parameters → ℝ → ℝ}
    {D E : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    {D₂ E₂ : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] (Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ)}
    {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hA : Continuous (Function.uncurry A)) (hB : Continuous (Function.uncurry B))
    (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D)) (hE : Continuous (Function.uncurry E))
    (hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂)) (hE₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry E₂))
    (hdA : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => A q s) (D p s) p)
    (hdB : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => B q s) (E p s) p)
    (hdD : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => D q s) (D₂ p s) p)
    (hdE : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => E q s) (E₂ p s) p) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, A p s * B p s)
records.proof:
by
  apply contDiff_two_parameter_intervalIntegral
    (G := fun p s => A p s * B p s)
    (D := fun p s => A p s • E p s + B p s • D p s)
    (D₂ := fun p s =>
      (A p s • E₂ p s + (D p s).smulRight (E p s)) +
      (B p s • D₂ p s + (E p s).smulRight (D p s))) hℓ
    (hA.mul hB) ((hA.smul hE).add (hB.smul hD))
    (((hA.smul hE₂).add (continuous_smulRight_parameter hD hE)).add
      ((hB.smul hD₂).add (continuous_smulRight_parameter hE hD)))
  · intro p s
    exact (hdA p s).mul (hdB p s)
  · intro p s
    exact ((hdA p s).smul (hdE p s)).add ((hdB p s).smul (hdD p s))

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_two_integral_primitive_mul
    {ρ τ θ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ρ) (hτ : ContDiff ℝ 2 τ)
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hB : Continuous B) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      (∫ q in 0..s, ρ (θ q + B q p)) * τ (θ s + B s p))
records.proof:
by
  let R := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) => ρ (θ s + B s p)
  let D := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) => deriv ρ (θ s + B s p) • B s
  let D₂ := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) =>
    (deriv (deriv ρ) (θ s + B s p) • B s).smulRight (B s)
  let T := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) => τ (θ s + B s p)
  let E := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) => deriv τ (θ s + B s p) • B s
  let E₂ := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) =>
    (deriv (deriv τ) (θ s + B s p) • B s).smulRight (B s)
  have hp : Continuous (fun q : Parameters × ℝ => θ q.2 + B q.2 q.1) :=
    (hθ.comp continuous_snd).add ((hB.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply continuous_fst)
  have hρ₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv ρ) := hρ.deriv'
  have hτ₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv τ) := hτ.deriv'
  have hR : Continuous (Function.uncurry R) := hρ.continuous.comp hp
  have hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D) :=
    (hρ₁.continuous.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd)
  have hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂) :=
    continuous_smulRight_parameter
      ((hρ₁.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
      (hB.comp continuous_snd)
  have hT : Continuous (Function.uncurry T) := hτ.continuous.comp hp
  have hE : Continuous (Function.uncurry E) :=
    (hτ₁.continuous.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd)
  have hE₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry E₂) :=
    continuous_smulRight_parameter
      ((hτ₁.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
      (hB.comp continuous_snd)
  have hdR (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) : HasFDerivAt (fun q => R q s) (D p s) p :=
    (hρ.differentiable (by norm_num) _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (θ s))
  have hdD (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) : HasFDerivAt (fun q => D q s) (D₂ p s) p :=
    ((hρ₁.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (θ s))).smul_const (B s)
  have hdT (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) : HasFDerivAt (fun q => T q s) (E p s) p :=
    (hτ.differentiable (by norm_num) _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (θ s))
  have hdE (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) : HasFDerivAt (fun q => E q s) (E₂ p s) p :=
    ((hτ₁.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (θ s))).smul_const (B s)
  exact contDiff_two_integral_mul
    (A := fun p s => ∫ q in 0..s, R p q) (B := T)
    (D := fun p s => ∫ q in 0..s, D p q) (E := E)
    (D₂ := fun p s => ∫ q in 0..s, D₂ p q) (E₂ := E₂) hℓ
    (continuous_parameter_primitive hR) hT
    (continuous_parameter_primitive hD) hE
    (continuous_parameter_primitive
      (E := Parameters →L[ℝ] (Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (G := D₂) hD₂) hE₂
    (fun p s => hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral_any hR hD hdR p)
    hdT
    (fun p s => hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral_any hD hD₂ hdD p)
    hdE

theorem contDiff_area_linear_parameters
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hB : Continuous B) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => area (fun s => θ s + B s p) ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  have h₁ := contDiff_two_integral_primitive_mul hℓ Real.contDiff_cos Real.contDiff_sin hθ hB
  have h₂ := contDiff_two_integral_primitive_mul hℓ Real.contDiff_sin Real.contDiff_cos hθ hB
  have he : (fun p => area (fun s => θ s + B s p) ℓ) =
      (fun p => (1 / 2) *
        ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, (∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q + B q p)) * sin (θ s + B s p)) -
         (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (∫ q in 0..s, sin (θ q + B q p)) * cos (θ s + B s p)))) := by
    funext p
    have hp : Continuous (fun s => θ s + B s p) := hθ.add (hB.clm_apply continuous_const)
    have hX : Continuous (xCoord (fun s => θ s + B s p) 0) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hasDerivAt_xCoord hp 0 s).continuousAt
    have hY : Continuous (yCoord (fun s => θ s + B s p) 0) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hasDerivAt_yCoord hp 0 s).continuousAt
    unfold area
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (μ := volume)
      (f := fun s => xCoord (fun s => θ s + B s p) 0 s * sin (θ s + B s p))
      (g := fun s => yCoord (fun s => θ s + B s p) 0 s * cos (θ s + B s p))
      ((hX.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hp)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
      ((hY.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hp)).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)]
    simp only [xCoord, yCoord, zero_add]
  rw [he]
  exact contDiff_const.mul (h₁.sub h₂)

theorem corrected_family_C1_close {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ)
    {a b c : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0) (hc : ContinuousAt c 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (hc0 : c 0 = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      |(θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) - θ s| < r ∧
      |deriv (fun u => θ u + t * η.val u + a t * ξ₁.val u + b t * ξ₂.val u + c t * ξ₃.val u) s -
        deriv θ s| < r
records.proof:
by
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    |η.val s| + |deriv η.val s| + |ξ₁.val s| + |deriv ξ₁.val s| +
      |ξ₂.val s| + |deriv ξ₂.val s| + |ξ₃.val s| + |deriv ξ₃.val s|
  have hG : Continuous G :=
    ((((((η.property.1.continuous.abs.add η.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs).add
      ξ₁.property.1.continuous.abs).add ξ₁.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs).add
        ξ₂.property.1.continuous.abs).add ξ₂.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs).add ξ₃.property.1.continuous.abs).add
      ξ₃.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hG.continuousOn
  have hbounds (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ) :
      |η.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv η.val s| ≤ C ∧
      |ξ₁.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv ξ₁.val s| ≤ C ∧
      |ξ₂.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv ξ₂.val s| ≤ C ∧
      |ξ₃.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv ξ₃.val s| ≤ C := by
    have hg : G s ≤ C := (le_abs_self (G s)).trans (by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC s hs)
    dsimp [G] at hg
    have h₁ := abs_nonneg (η.val s)
    have h₂ := abs_nonneg (deriv η.val s)
    have h₃ := abs_nonneg (ξ₁.val s)
    have h₄ := abs_nonneg (deriv ξ₁.val s)
    have h₅ := abs_nonneg (ξ₂.val s)
    have h₆ := abs_nonneg (deriv ξ₂.val s)
    have h₇ := abs_nonneg (ξ₃.val s)
    have h₈ := abs_nonneg (deriv ξ₃.val s)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => (|t| + |a t| + |b t| + |c t|) * C) 0 :=
    (((continuousAt_id.abs.add ha.abs).add hb.abs).add hc.abs).mul continuousAt_const
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), (|t| + |a t| + |b t| + |c t|) * C < r :=
    hcont.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by simpa [ha0, hb0, hc0] using hr))
  filter_upwards [hsmall] with t ht
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇, h₈⟩ := hbounds s hs
  have hd : deriv (fun u => θ u + t * η.val u + a t * ξ₁.val u + b t * ξ₂.val u + c t * ξ₃.val u) s =
      deriv θ s + t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s + b t * deriv ξ₂.val s + c t * deriv ξ₃.val s :=
    (((((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.add
      ((η.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul t)).add
        ((ξ₁.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (a t))).add
          ((ξ₂.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (b t))).add
            ((ξ₃.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (c t))).deriv
  constructor
  · have he : θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s - θ s =
        t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact (abs_four_term_bound h₁ h₃ h₅ h₇).trans_lt ht
  · rw [hd]
    have he : deriv θ s + t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s +
        b t * deriv ξ₂.val s + c t * deriv ξ₃.val s - deriv θ s =
        t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s + b t * deriv ξ₂.val s + c t * deriv ξ₃.val s := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact (abs_four_term_bound h₂ h₄ h₆ h₈).trans_lt ht

theorem hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_feasible {k ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ)
    {a b c : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt a 0 0) (hb : HasDerivAt b 0 0)
    (hc : HasDerivAt c 0 0) (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (hc0 : c 0 = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => energy (fun q => k*q^2/2)
      (fun s => θ s + t*η.val s + a t*ξ₁.val s + b t*ξ₂.val s + c t*ξ₃.val s) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, k * deriv θ s * deriv η.val s) 0
records.proof:
by
  let B := LinearInputAreaParameters.parameterLinear
    (deriv η.val) (deriv ξ₁.val) (deriv ξ₂.val) (deriv ξ₃.val)
  have hB : Continuous B := LinearInputAreaParameters.continuous_parameterLinear
    η.property.1.continuous_deriv_one ξ₁.property.1.continuous_deriv_one
    ξ₂.property.1.continuous_deriv_one ξ₃.property.1.continuous_deriv_one
  have hf := LinearInputAreaParameters.hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters
    hℓ (show ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun q : ℝ => k*q^2/2) by fun_prop)
      hθ.continuous_deriv_one hB (0 : LinearInputAreaParameters.Parameters)
  have hden (q : ℝ) : deriv (fun q : ℝ => k*q^2/2) q = k*q :=
    (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt k q).deriv
  have hf' : HasFDerivAt
      (fun p : LinearInputAreaParameters.Parameters => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, k*(deriv θ s+B s p)^2/2)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (k*deriv θ s) • B s) (0, (a 0, (b 0, c 0))) := by
    convert hf using 1 <;> simp only [map_zero, add_zero, hden, ha0, hb0, hc0]
    rfl
  have hp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t, (a t, (b t, c t))))
      (1, (0, (0, 0))) 0 := (hasDerivAt_id 0).prodMk (ha.prodMk (hb.prodMk hc))
  have hd := hf'.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hp
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => (k*deriv θ s) • B s) volume 0 ℓ :=
    ((continuous_const.mul hθ.continuous_deriv_one).smul hB).intervalIntegrable _ _
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply hint] at hd
  have he : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, k*(deriv θ s+B s (t,(a t,(b t,c t))))^2/2) =
      (fun t => energy (fun q => k*q^2/2)
        (fun s => θ s+t*η.val s+a t*ξ₁.val s+b t*ξ₂.val s+c t*ξ₃.val s) ℓ) := by
    funext t
    unfold energy
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    have hds := (((((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.add
      ((η.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul t)).add
      ((ξ₁.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (a t))).add
      ((ξ₂.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (b t))).add
      ((ξ₃.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (c t))).deriv
    change deriv (fun u => θ u+t*η.val u+a t*ξ₁.val u+b t*ξ₂.val u+c t*ξ₃.val u) s =
      deriv θ s+t*deriv η.val s+a t*deriv ξ₁.val s+b t*deriv ξ₂.val s+c t*deriv ξ₃.val s at hds
    dsimp only
    rw [hds]
    dsimp [B]
    rw [LinearInputAreaParameters.parameterLinear_apply]
    congr 2; ring
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hd
  rw [he] at hd
  simpa only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, B,
    LinearInputAreaParameters.parameterLinear_apply, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] using hd

theorem fderiv_constraintParameters_zero {θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η)
    (hξ₁ : Continuous ξ₁) (hξ₂ : Continuous ξ₂) (hξ₃ : Continuous ξ₃)
    (p : Parameters) :
    fderiv ℝ (constraintParameters θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ℓ) 0 p =
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p),
       ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p),
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) *
          parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p)))
records.proof:
by
  let ζ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p
  have hζ : Continuous ζ :=
    (continuous_parameterLinear hη hξ₁ hξ₂ hξ₃).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hx := hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation hℓ hθ hζ
  have hy := hasDerivAt_vertical_variation hℓ hθ hζ
  have ha := LinearInputAreaVariation.hasDerivAt_area_variation hθ hζ ℓ
  have hadj : HasDerivAt
      (fun t => LinearInputAreaVariation.area (angleVariation θ ζ t) ℓ -
        yCoord θ 0 ℓ / 2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * ζ s)) +
        xCoord θ 0 ℓ / 2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * ζ s)))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * ζ s) 0 := by
    convert (ha.sub (hx.const_mul (yCoord θ 0 ℓ / 2))).add
      (hy.const_mul (xCoord θ 0 ℓ / 2)) using 1
    simp only [neg_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    ring
  have hd : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => constraintParameters θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ℓ (t • p))
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ s),
        ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ s),
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * ζ s))) 0 := by
    convert hx.prodMk (hy.prodMk hadj) using 1
    simp only [constraintParameters, areaParameters, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ζ]
    rfl
  have hf := (contDiff_constraintParameters hℓ hθ hη hξ₁ hξ₂ hξ₃).differentiable
    (by norm_num)
  have hfd : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => constraintParameters θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ℓ (t • p))
      (fderiv ℝ (constraintParameters θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ℓ) 0 p) 0 := by
    have hfp : HasFDerivAt (constraintParameters θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ℓ)
        (fderiv ℝ (constraintParameters θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ℓ) 0) ((0 : ℝ) • p) := by
      simpa only [zero_smul] using (hf (0 : Parameters)).hasFDerivAt
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • p) p 0 := by
      simpa only [id_eq, one_smul] using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const p
    exact hfp.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hp
  exact hfd.unique hd

records.statement:
theorem integral_parameterLinear {η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ w : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hη : Continuous η) (hξ₁ : Continuous ξ₁) (hξ₂ : Continuous ξ₂)
    (hξ₃ : Continuous ξ₃) (hw : Continuous w) (p : Parameters) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p) =
      p.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * η s) +
      p.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * ξ₁ s) +
      p.2.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * ξ₂ s) +
      p.2.2.2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * ξ₃ s)
records.proof:
by
  have hiη : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => p.1 * (w s * η s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hw.mul hη)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hi₁ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => p.2.1 * (w s * ξ₁ s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hw.mul hξ₁)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hi₂ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => p.2.2.1 * (w s * ξ₂ s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hw.mul hξ₂)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hi₃ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => p.2.2.2 * (w s * ξ₃ s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hw.mul hξ₃)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  calc
    _ = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, p.1 * (w s * η s) + p.2.1 * (w s * ξ₁ s) +
        p.2.2.1 * (w s * ξ₂ s) + p.2.2.2 * (w s * ξ₃ s) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      dsimp only
      rw [parameterLinear_apply]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hiη.add hi₁).add hi₂) hi₃,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add (hiη.add hi₁) hi₂,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add hiη hi₁]
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

theorem exists_implicit_correction {f : Parameters → ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (ht : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) = 0)
    (hc : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g 0 ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt g 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, f (t, g t) = f 0
records.proof:
by
  have hi : ((fderiv ℝ f 0).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hc]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), rfl⟩
  let h := hf.contDiffAt (x := (0 : Parameters))
  let g := h.implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi
  refine ⟨g, h.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi,
    h.implicitFunction_apply_self (by norm_num) hi, ?_,
    h.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi⟩
  have hd := h.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi
  rw [ht] at hd
  simpa using hd.hasFDerivAt.hasDerivAt

theorem exists_exact_area_variation {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K)
    (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hηx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηa : (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ, ∃ a b c : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 c 0 ∧
      a 0 = 0 ∧ b 0 = 0 ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt a 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt b 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt c 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos
          (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin
          (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) ∧
        LinearInputAreaVariation.area
          (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) ℓ =
            LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, ξ₃, ⟨hx₁, hy₁, ha₁⟩, ⟨hx₂, hy₂, ha₂⟩, ⟨hx₃, hy₃, ha₃⟩⟩ :=
    LinearInputAreaRegularity.exists_normalized_constraint_directions hℓ hθ hnonconst
  let f := constraintParameters θ η.val ξ₁.val ξ₂.val ξ₃.val ℓ
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f := contDiff_constraintParameters hℓ.le hθ.continuous
    η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous ξ₃.property.1.continuous
  have hd (p : Parameters) := fderiv_constraintParameters_zero hℓ.le hθ.continuous
    η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous ξ₃.property.1.continuous p
  have hi (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w) (p : Parameters) :=
    integral_parameterLinear (ℓ := ℓ) η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous
      ξ₂.property.1.continuous ξ₃.property.1.continuous hw p
  have ht : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro t
    change fderiv ℝ f 0 (t, (0, (0, 0))) = (0, (0, 0))
    rw [hd]
    rw [hi (fun s => -sin (θ s)) (by fun_prop), hi _ hθ.cos.continuous,
      hi _ (LinearInputAreaVariation.continuous_moment hθ.continuous)]
    simp only [hηx, hηy, hηa, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hc : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro p
    change fderiv ℝ f 0 (0, p) = p
    rw [hd]
    rw [hi (fun s => -sin (θ s)) (by fun_prop), hi _ hθ.cos.continuous,
      hi _ (LinearInputAreaVariation.continuous_moment hθ.continuous)]
    rw [hx₁, hy₁, ha₁, hx₂, hy₂, ha₂, hx₃, hy₃, ha₃]
    simp
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg₀, hgd, hge⟩ := exists_implicit_correction hf ht hc
  refine ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, ξ₃, (fun t => (g t).1), (fun t => (g t).2.1),
    (fun t => (g t).2.2), hg.fst, hg.snd.fst, hg.snd.snd,
    congrArg Prod.fst hg₀, congrArg (fun q => q.2.1) hg₀,
    congrArg (fun q => q.2.2) hg₀, hgd.fst, hgd.snd.fst, hgd.snd.snd, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hge] with t ht
  simp only [add_assoc]
  have hx := congrArg Prod.fst ht
  have hy := congrArg (fun q => q.2.1) ht
  have ha := congrArg (fun q => q.2.2) ht
  simp [f, constraintParameters, areaParameters, parameterLinear_apply, add_assoc] at hx hy ha
  refine ⟨hx, hy, ?_⟩
  rw [hx, hy] at ha
  linarith
records.comment:
Every first-order feasible direction at a nonconstant-curvature curve is
realized by an actual C²-parameter family preserving both endpoint coordinates
and signed area exactly.  All three correction derivatives vanish at zero.

theorem locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hmin : LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ) {a b c : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0) (hc : ContinuousAt c 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (hc0 : c 0 = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos
        (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin
        (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) ∧
      LinearInputAreaVariation.area
        (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) ℓ =
          LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ ℓ) :
    IsLocalMin (fun t => energy (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2)
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) ℓ) 0
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hminimal⟩ := hmin
  have hclose := LinearInputAreaFamily.corrected_family_C1_close hθ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃
    ha hb hc ha0 hb0 hc0 hr
  change ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
    energy (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2)
      (fun s => θ s + 0 * η.val s + a 0 * ξ₁.val s + b 0 * ξ₂.val s + c 0 * ξ₃.val s) ℓ ≤ _
  simp only [ha0, hb0, hc0, zero_mul, add_zero]
  filter_upwards [hclose, hexact] with t ht hx
  apply hminimal
    (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)
  · exact (((hθ.add (contDiff_const.mul η.property.1)).add
      (contDiff_const.mul ξ₁.property.1)).add
        (contDiff_const.mul ξ₂.property.1)).add (contDiff_const.mul ξ₃.property.1)
  · simp only [η.property.2.1, ξ₁.property.2.1, ξ₂.property.2.1, ξ₃.property.2.1,
      mul_zero, add_zero]
  · simp only [η.property.2.2, ξ₁.property.2.2, ξ₂.property.2.2, ξ₃.property.2.2,
      mul_zero, add_zero]
  · exact hx.1
  · exact hx.2.1
  · exact hx.2.2
  · exact ht
records.comment:
An exact family induces a scalar local minimum from the actual C¹
comparison hypothesis.  Local minimality of the scalar path is not assumed.

records.proof:
by
  by_cases hconst : ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K
  · obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hconst
    exact LinearInputAreaRegularity.areaStationary_of_constant_curvature hℓ hθ hK
  · intro η hx hy ha
    have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
    have hx' := (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation hℓ.le hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous).deriv.symm.trans hx
    have hy' := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation hℓ.le hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous).deriv.symm.trans hy
    have ha' := (LinearInputAreaVariation.hasDerivAt_area_variation_feasible
      hℓ.le hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous hx' hy').deriv.symm.trans ha
    obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, ξ₃, a, b, c, hca, hcb, hcc, ha0, hb0, hc0, hda, hdb, hdc, hexact⟩ :=
      LinearInputAreaExactVariation.exists_exact_area_variation hℓ hθ hconst η hx' hy' ha'
    have hm := locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family hθ1 hmin η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃
      hca.continuousAt hcb.continuousAt hcc.continuousAt ha0 hb0 hc0 hexact
    have hd := LinearInputAreaFamily.hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_feasible (k := k) hℓ.le hθ1
      η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ hda hdb hdc ha0 hb0 hc0
    have hz := hd.deriv.symm.trans hm.deriv_eq_zero
    have he := (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ.le
      (show ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) by fun_prop)
        hθ1 η.property.1).deriv
    have hquad (q : ℝ) : deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) q = k * q :=
      (quadratic_density_hasDerivAt k q).deriv
    simp_rw [hquad] at he
    exact he.trans hz

theorem locallyMinimizing_curvature {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ) (hmin : LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ) :
    ∃ p σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = p

by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := LinearInputPressureStationary.areaStationary_exists_pressure
    hℓ.le (hθ.of_le (by norm_num)) (locallyMinimizing_areaStationary hℓ hθ hmin)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := LinearInputPressureStationary.stationary_curvature hℓ hθ hp
  exact ⟨p, σ, hσ⟩

The pressure forcing is a conclusion of exact-area constrained local
minimality, with its coefficient supplied by the multiplier theorem.

theorem locallyMinimizing_phase_energy {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ) :
    ∃ p σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      LinearInputDesign.E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (LinearInputGradient.gy (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-LinearInputGradient.gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  exact LinearInputPressureStationary.areaStationary_phase_energy hℓ hk hθ
    (locallyMinimizing_areaStationary hℓ hθ hmin)
